limitations: Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout (327c5c4), not the family pin.
Behaviour is one headless Chromium with software WebGL (SwiftShader) on one machine: it shows outcomes, not pixels or frame rate.
The tapes were recorded by the game's own AI driving the player's car, not by people; a tape proves one way round a circuit, not that the medal targets are fair. The tandem tape's chaser grades D.
Handling windows were set by the builders from genre practice and real-car figures, not from playtests.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.

not_run.reason: Stills, a clip and a side-by-side A/B were reviewed by the builders only (reviews changed the start-gantry lights, the clip's smoke density, the car screen's fold, the phone framing and a stale HUD still); the owner has not looked at or played the game yet.

No person has played it. The AI, scripted keyboard drivers and scripted exploit drivers finished, drifted or failed to farm every circuit; that proves possible and not trivially farmable, not fun, fair or well paced, and says nothing about keyboard, pad or touch feel or the sound.
Tapes were replayed in Node (V8) and Chromium (V8) only; Firefox (SpiderMonkey) and Safari (JavaScriptCore) were not run.
No strict host copy was published for this run.
